definitions.explanation: The reason why something happens or exists.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原因|げんいん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

notes:
{原因|げんいん} means cause or origin - the reason why something happened.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原因|げんいん}: the cause of ~
- {原因|げんいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to investigate the cause
- {原因|げんいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to find out the cause
